sources.title: European Accessibility Act (EAA)
sources.why: Requires consumer-facing mHealth apps and onboarding flows to meet WCAG 2.1 AA so people with disabilities can use them.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 82304-2 — health software quality & safety
sources.why: Its quality dimensions cover usability and accessibility, the core concerns of user-centered design for non-device health apps.
